title: Connect to Redis — Python, JavaScript & Java
title_es: Conectar a Redis — Python, JavaScript y Java
description: Runnable Redis connection examples: redis-py from_url with pool and pipeline, ioredis with retry strategy and pub/sub, and JedisPooled with a Lua rate limiter, plus a docker-compose Redis 7 instance.
description_es: Ejemplos ejecutables de conexión a Redis: redis-py from_url con pool y pipeline, ioredis con retry strategy y pub/sub, y JedisPooled con un limitador de tasa en Lua, con Redis 7 en docker-compose.
